title: Bolsista Doutor - Akiyama - Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Akiyama é referência nacional no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de identificação e segurança, com soluções inovadoras que atendem a setores como segurança pública, bancos, empresas privadas e órgãos governamentais. Nosso foco é criar produtos de alto desempenho em biometria, inteligência artificial e segurança da informação, sempre impulsionando a inovação e a transformação digital.

Estamos buscando um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nosso time de P&D, contribuindo no desenvolvimento de soluções que combinam computação quântica, IA e cibersegurança aplicadas à biometria.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica, Física Aplicada, ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria

Principais Atividades:

  • Propor arquiteturas híbridas (clássica + quântica) para otimização de tempo de processamento em sistemas biométricos;
  • Simular hardware quântico ou utilizar computadores quânticos reais em nuvem (IBM Quantum, D-Wave, Rigetti, entre outros);
  • Aplicar criptografia, física computacional, inteligência artificial e cibersegurança aos produtos da empresa.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Criptografia quântica e algoritmos pós-quânticos (ex.: Lattice-based cryptography);
  • Computação quântica: modelos de computação (gate-based, annealing), uso de Qiskit ou similares, circuitos quânticos e simulação de algoritmos;
  • Machine Learning e Deep Learning aplicados à biometria;
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de IA (TensorFlow, PyTorch) e frameworks quânticos (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane).
  • Inglês Avançado.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Processamento de sinais biométricos (impressões digitais, face, íris, palma da mão, voz, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em teorias de informação e codificação para proteção de templates biométricos (ex.: cancelable biometrics, fuzzy extractors).

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho: Híbrido

Local: Curitiba/PR

Soft Skills: Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Organização.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the 'BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client's data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Requirements

Please share your resume in English.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer

LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil

REPortS TO:

R&D Manager

Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.

Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.

Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.

Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.

Education:

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.

Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.

Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.

Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.

Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world's best-loved brands: M&M's, SNICKERS, TWIX, MILKY WAY, DOVE, PEDIGREE, ROYAL CANIN, WHISKAS, EXTRA, ORBIT, 5TM, SKITTLES, BEN'S ORIGINAL, and COCOAVIA. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world's pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet HospitalsTM, BluePearl, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCATM and Pet PartnersTM. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we're striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

Ao se juntar a nós, você terá acesso a uma série de benefícios pensados para promover seu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
ZTE is looking for Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager

Role Purpose

We are seeking a senior Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager to act as the single owner and authority for all Anatel regulatory compliance and product certification activities in Brazil.

This role is critical to ensuring the company's ability to import, commercialize, deploy, and operate telecommunications products in the Brazilian market, while enabling speed-to-market, commercial competitiveness, and long-term regulatory sustainability.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, strong interaction with Global HQ, and direct influence on revenue, deployment, and customer trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full lifecycle of Anatel homologation and product certification activities, including planning, execution, publication, maintenance, renewals, and amendments.
  • Act as the single point of accountability with Anatel, OCDs (Designated Certification Bodies), and accredited laboratories.
  • Define and execute regulatory strategies per product family, balancing compliance, cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate and validate all regulatory and technical documentation, including test reports, declarations of conformity, manuals in Portuguese, and technical files.
  • Assess the regulatory impact of hardware, firmware, RF, and configuration changes, enforcing regulatory gates and blocking deployments when compliance is at risk.
  • Ensure strict alignment between certified configurations and field-deployed products, SKUs, and software versions.
  • Support Sales, Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Supply Chain with regulatory validation for RFPs, RFQs, imports, and network deployments.
  • Maintain an audit-ready regulatory repository and manage interactions with Anatel during audits, inspections, and formal inquiries.
  • Monitor homologation validity dates and proactively manage renewals to prevent service disruption or import blocks.
  • Continuously improve certification lead time, cost efficiency, and regulatory predictability through optimization strategies.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Interface directly with Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Product Engineering, Test & Certification, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Translate global product roadmaps and engineering changes into Brazilian regulatory requirements and execution plans.
  • Act as the internal regulatory authority and trusted advisor on Brazilian telecommunications regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in regulatory affairs, product certification, or compliance within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Anatel homologation processes, especially for Class III (network infrastructure) equipment.
  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, EMC, electrical safety, and telecom network technologies (RAN, MW, IP, Optical, CPE).
  • English as primary working language is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required; Advanced Mandarin is desirable.
  • Ability to operate autonomously with strong ownership, sound judgment, and assertive decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

Zero expired or non-compliant homologations.

No import blocks or deployment delays caused by regulatory issues.

Reduced certification lead time and re-test costs.

Full regulatory visibility and predictability for leadership, engineering, and sales.

Recognition as the internal authority on Anatel and Brazilian telecom regulation.

Why This Role Matters

This is strategic, technical, and business-critical role when you can face challenge and develop yourself.

Without regulatory compliance, products do not enter the country and networks do not go live.

With strong regulatory leadership, the company operates faster, safer, and more competitively in Brazil.

Are you interested in being part of our team? Please apply for this opportunity and attach your resume in English. Kindly note that only English resumes will be considered.

description:
Unidade de Negócio: Sem Parar Empresas

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Missão da área: Conectar empresas a soluções inovadoras de mobilidade e gestão, impulsionando a eficiência e a produtividade por meio do portfólio Sem Parar Empresas. Nosso compromisso é oferecer um atendimento consultivo e estratégico, garantindo a melhor experiência para os clientes e contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.

Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Gerentes de contas você será responsável por vender o portfólio Sem Parar Empresas, oferecendo soluções de abastecimento de acordo com a necessidade de cada cliente. Além disso, será responsável por inserir informações no Salesforce, construir o funil de vendas, abrir novos mercados e buscar novas oportunidades. Também deverá gerir o pipeline, manter um fluxo de vendas consistente e acompanhar as implantações, com o objetivo de atingir as metas de receita inicial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar contato ágil com os leads recebidos por meio dos canais disponíveis (telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp), atuando na qualificação e conversão de oportunidades.
  • Conduzir reuniões presenciais e virtuais com prospects e clientes para levantamento de necessidades, entendimento do projeto e apresentação de soluções personalizadas.
  • Registrar todas as interações comerciais (ligações, e-mails e reuniões) no Salesforce, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade das informações.
  • Criar e gerenciar oportunidades no Salesforce, elaborar propostas comerciais, realizar follow-ups estratégicos e atuar ativamente no fechamento das negociações.
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, assegurando o início da operação conforme contratado e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, mantendo previsões realistas e controle das etapas das oportunidades.
  • Garantir a conclusão das vendas por meio do acompanhamento remoto ou presencial dos clientes, monitorando o fluxo de utilização para impulsionar o crescimento e o faturamento da carteira.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas internas, especialmente com o time de pós-vendas, garantindo alinhamento e excelência na jornada do cliente.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo.
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e gestão de funil de vendas.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You'll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You'll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You'll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken); confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You've contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based (fully remote)

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV in English, and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client's go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

A LiuGong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo LiuGong. Desde 2015 fabricando equipamentos no país, a LiuGong vem crescendo nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano. O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos. E os principais produtos incluem carregadeiras de rodas, escavadeiras, motoniveladoras, rolos compactadores, retroescavadeiras, escavadeiras, caminhões rígidos, plataformas aéreas de trabalho, etc. Além disso, a LiuGong continua desenvolvendo a estrutura de sua fábrica e centro de treinamento localizado na cidade de Mogi Guaçu e escritório comercial na cidade de Campinas e Belo Horizonte, fortalecendo o corpo de profissionais e qualificando o portfólio de produtos.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, and Brazilian office in Barueri, SP, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas ("RNG") from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let's accelerate the energy transition together.

The Sales Engineer plays a key role in achieving sales targets for Greenlane's biogas desulfurization and upgrading systems by combining strong technical expertise with commercial acumen. This role provides vital support to the sales team by developing sales proposals that meet the needs of our customers through a portfolio of configure-to-order products across a number of product lines. You will support the sales process by joining the Commercial Director in customer meetings and completing customer-focused activities necessary to advance opportunities through the sales pipeline. You will also influence the direction of Greenlane's product roadmap by sharing internally voice-of-customer feedback and engaging with and supporting the global product management team.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of Greenlane's full suite of biogas desulfurization and upgrading technologies and product lines, including product attributes, benefits over the competition, selling features, and configurable parameters, and and apply this knowledge to develop compelling sales proposals for existing and new prospective customers in Brazil and across Latin America.
  • Maintain and continuously update a database of technical and commercial information to ensure prompt, clear, and accurate responses to client inquiries and to capture voice-of-customer feedback.
  • Support Commercial Director in customer meetings and on sales calls to progress opportunities through the sales pipeline.
  • Evaluate and clearly communicate the advantages and trade-offs of various technical solutions to help clients identify the most suitable approach for their specific project requirements.
  • Differentiate and articulate the value proposition of Greenlane's solutions compared to competing offerings within the industry.
  • Prepare detailed technical and commercial proposals that effectively translate complex engineering concepts into compelling client-focused solutions.
  • Ensure that all client interactions are conducted in a professional, organized, and timely manner that reinforces Greenlane's reputation for integrity, quality, responsiveness, creativity, and thought-leadership.
  • Foster collaborative relationships with internal teams, EPC ́s, suppliers, and customers to ensure alignment and to set up the project execution teams for success.
  • Proactively identify and recommend improvements to internal processes, workflows, and solution offerings.
  • Build and maintain strong networks within the biomethane industry to stay informed on emerging technologies, market trends, and potential business opportunities.
  • Accurately document and manage all sales activities within the company's CRM system.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline) and a minimum of 5 years of experience in a Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales capacity within a technology-driven environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Technical expertise in air or gas compression, purification, treatment, or separation—ideally with exposure to natural gas or biomethane applications.
  • Professional working proficiency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.
  • Strong understanding of solution-based selling, including the ability to identify customer pain points and communicate how Greenlane's technology uniquely meets their needs.
  • Familiarity with the biogas and biomethane markets in Brazil is a strong asset.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, proactive, and passionate about clean technology, with a proven record of delivering customer-focused solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and rapport across multiple organizational levels.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities with a track record of managing competing priorities under tight deadlines.
  • A collaborative, positive, and proactive team player who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

description:

  • Segregar materiais e alocar produtos em prateleiras, estrados e áreas internas.
  • Controlar o estoque, verificando datas de vencimento e atualizando as Fichas de Segurança (FDS).
  • Acompanhar inventários mensais e realizar ajustes de divergências no pré-inventário.
  • Atender requisições de materiais e realizar a baixa eletrônica no sistema.
  • Auxiliar na emissão de notas fiscais e na confecção de requisições internas (APL/DPA).
  • Prestar suporte no atendimento a solicitações de compras e acompanhar auditorias.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas sob orientação.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: Auditor externo
description:
O grupo líder mundial em Teste, Inspeção e Certificação, está com vagas de emprego abertas para o Projeto 2026 em Cruz Alta e região.

A vaga é para autuar como auditor agrícola em um dos maiores projetos da empresa à nível nacional, uma oportunidade para contribuir com o desenvolvimento da qualidade no agronegócio nacional. Não é necessário experiência prévia. Os selecionados passarão por imersão no Projeto, recebendo treinamento sobre as atividades e uso dos sistemas de inspeção, a primeira fase de seleção é realizada integralmente online.

Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira. Se é você, adoraríamos conversar.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos buscando Auditores Agrícolas que contribuirão com atividades de coleta de dados através do acompanhamento de testes transgênicos em pontos de recebimento de soja (PDR's) em silos, armazéns e cooperativas. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social.

Atividades:

  • Visitar PDRs (armazéns);
  • Garantir execução das metodologias;
  • Revisão das informações coletadas em campo;
  • Comunicação tempestiva com os líderes alinhamento das divergências encontradas;
  • Verificação de formulários e validação dos dados coletados em campo.

O que buscamos:

  • Disponibilidade total de horários (inclusive aos finais de semana);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • CNH B ativa (preferencialmente, não obrigatório);
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Possibilidade de atuar na sua cidade e em regiões do Sul (caso necessário);
  • Facilidade em manuseio de tecnologias (tablets e smartphone);
  • Ética, responsabilidade, comprometimento, organização

Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 (Dois mil reais)

  • Vale alimentação R$1.800 mensal sendo esse valor dividido (parte vale alimentação e parte folha de pagamento)
  • Auxilio lavanderia R$100 mensais pro auditor móvel
  • Crédito de celular R$50 mensais
  • Seguro de vida

Contrato Temporario- (Safrista Clt)

As vagas são Disponibilizadas de forma intermitente, ou seja, selecionado por demanda de trabalho. Em caso de viagens a empresa custeia todas as despesas.

Candidatos contratados que se destacarem em suas funções poderão ser efetivados em diferentes cargos e setores dentro da empresa, além de terem prioridade de contratação em outros projetos pontuais da divisão de Agronegócios.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.

They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.

Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.

Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.

Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.

O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

O Engenheiro de Software Full Stack terá como desafios propor soluções para o marketplace com o foco em facilitar a vida do nosso cliente para usar nosso sistema de forma eficiente e satisfatória para realizar compras e continuar com nosso cliente ao longo da jornada.

O que esperamos de você:

title: Especialista ServiceNow ITOM / CMDB
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

#LI-CR1

#LI-ONSITE

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Liderar e operar ITOM Discovery, configurando probes, patterns, schedules, IP ranges, behaviors, classifiers e monitorando execução via ECC Queue e logs.
  • Instalar, registrar e tunar MID Servers (capabilities, clustering, threads, Java wrapper), garantindo saúde, performance e upgrades.
  • Criar e administrar credenciais (WMI/WinRM, SSH, SNMP v2/v3, VMware, JDBC) e integrações com Vault e credential alias.
  • Governar Identifier Rules e Reconciliation Definitions, controlando precedência por fonte e protegendo atributos técnicos críticos.
  • Operar e otimizar Normalization Data Services (NDS), Reclassification e Deduplication Rules, acompanhando atualizações da biblioteca de normalização.
  • Modelar e governar a CMDB alinhada ao CSDM, estruturando classes, relacionamentos e serviços (Application Service, Service Offering, Infra CIs).
  • Construir, validar e publicar Service Maps, garantindo critérios mínimos de qualidade (ex: ≥ 80% de dependências confirmadas).
  • Configurar e evoluir Event Management, incluindo fontes de eventos, correlação, priorização, mapeamento evento→CI/serviço e dashboards de saúde.
  • Criar e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores de qualidade de dados, como completeness, correctness, freshness, Discovery Success e CMDB Health.
  • Atuar na governança dentro do ServiceNow, documentando decisões, runbooks e organizando demandas em módulos Agile/PPM e Knowledge.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Experiência sólida (mínimo 3 anos) com ServiceNow ITOM e CMDB/CSDM.
  • Domínio prático de:
  • Discovery (patterns, probes, classifiers, behaviors, ECC Queue)
  • MID Server (cluster, health, tuning, capabilities)
  • Credentials e Affinities
  • Identifier & Reconciliation
  • Normalization (NDS) e Dedup
  • CMDB Health e Data Certification
  • Service Mapping Designer
  • Event Management (correlação, dashboards e priorização)
  • Experiência com integrações nativas do ServiceNow ITOM, como vCenter e Cloud Discovery.
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting técnico dentro da plataforma.

Certificações Desejáveis

  • CSA – Certified System Administrator
  • CIS – Discovery
  • CIS – Service Mapping
  • ITOM Specialist / ITOM Implementation
  • ITIL 4 (diferencial)

Diferenciais:

  • Perfil hands-on, com autonomia técnica e visão de arquitetura.
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em qualidade de dados e governança.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Organização e disciplina para documentação dentro do ServiceNow.

title: Consultor(a) de Viagens Junior | Blumenau
description:
Se você é apaixonado por resolver problemas e desenvolver soluções, e quer trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta em um ambiente dinâmico, esta vaga é para você!

Somos uma empresa com resultados incríveis, crescendo rápido e ainda com muito a ser estruturado, criado, testado, adaptado, expandido - grande oportunidade para colocar em prática seus conhecimentos, ser muito reconhecido, deixar sua marca na nossa história (e uma marcona no seu currículo). Buscamos resultados ambiciosos para os próximos anos e atingi-los só depende de nós - trabalhando juntos e próximos.

Trabalhar como Consultor de Viagens é uma excelente oportunidade de agregar ao negócio e conquistar bagagem. Você aprenderá muito sobre nosso produto, como necessidades dos clientes, o funcionamento das outras áreas e de forma geral sobre os softwares tipo SaaS. Você ajudará nossos clientes a ter melhores resultados, a partir da melhor utilização do nosso produto!

Somos uma empresa de pessoas inovadoras, criativas e diversas, então estamos super abertos a recebê-lo(a) com a sua diversidade.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD)

Fará parte do seu dia a dia:

  • Atender clientes para cotação, reserva e emissão de serviços de viagens.
  • Prestar consultoria de viagem;
  • Realizar o suporte aos nossos clientes respondendo a mensagens no chat, e-mails;
  • Conversar com os clientes, analisar uso, entender eventuais motivos pelos quais o cliente está com alguma dificuldade;
  • Orientar clientes nas suas necessidades de viagens.
  • Propor melhorias no sistema e no modelo de trabalho;
  • Reportar ao time técnico caso a dificuldade do cliente seja por um problema do sistema;
  • Coletar feedback e sugestões de clientes;
  • Participar de projetos, dar sugestões e ações para ajudar a construir a melhor solução de viagens corporativas da America Latina.

O que eu preciso saber?

  • Experiência em operação a viagens, preferencialmente corporativas;
  • Conhecimento em portais de fornecedores: cia áereas diretas, portais de operadoras e consolidadoras, locadoras de carro;
  • Conhecimento em operação via self-booking tool será um diferencial: ARGO, RESERVE ou Lemontech;
  • Experiência em sistemas de GDS será um diferencial.

title: Sales Manager
description:
At APP Group, we're not just supplying sustainable paper and packaging, we're reshaping the future of responsible business. As one of the world's largest integrated pulp and paper companies, with over 100,000 employees delivering products to more than 150 countries, APP Group combines global scale with local agility.

Learn more about our Sustainability Roadmap Vision 2030 and Forest Conservation Policy, and watch this video about our Regenesis Sustainability Program.

We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager to drive commercial growth across Latin America for our Industrial White Board range. You will be responsible for building strategic customer relationships, identifying opportunities, and growing APP's market presence in the region.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop and expand sales pipelines for our Industrial White Board business unit. Products include FBB, SBS, WLC and Food Packaging Board.
  • Lead negotiations and execute account strategies to achieve sales and margin targets.
  • Provide insights on customer needs, competitor activity, and regional market dynamics.
  • Collaborate with APP teams in Indonesia to support customer satisfaction.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years' B2B sales experience in Folding Box Board, Solid Bleached Board, White-Lined Chipboard and Food Packaging Board.
  • Strong knowledge of Latin American markets.
  • Fluent in English; additional regional languages are a plus.
  • Degree in Business, International Trade, Sales or related field preferred.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools and digital sales reporting.
  • Willingness to travel frequently.

The successful candidate will be appointed through CATHAY LATIN AMERICA LTDA, APP's exclusive sales and marketing subsidiary in Brazil.

Why Join APP?

  • Be part of a globally respected brand with unmatched production scale.
  • Join a strategic growth division in a high-potential market.
  • Collaborate with international teams.
  • Contribute to a sustainability-driven organization with long-term growth opportunities.

Equal Opportunity

APP is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background.

Interested?

Apply now to join APP's global commercial leadership team. Only candidates with relevant experience in the tissue industry will be considered.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Senior - Delphi
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

Nossa tecnologia dita o ritmo do mercado. Afinal, 25% do PIB brasileiro passa pelos softwares presentes em mais de 40 mil empresas clientes da TOTVS.

Para que isso aconteça precisamos ser ágeis, pois as coisas aqui acontecem em uma velocidade acima da média. No nosso dia-dia, aprendemos muito e muito rápido, em um ambiente leve, divertido e desafiador. Nosso time de tecnologia tem a ousadia para colocar todo esse aprendizado e conhecimento em prática. Assim, transformando todos os setores da economia por meio da tecnologia.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com baixo nível de supervisão e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a fundo a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de média e alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento.
  • Utiliza frameworks já definidos para o desenvolvimento de soluções.

REQUISITOS ESSENCIAIS

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de aplicações através do Delphi;
  • Desenvolvimento de objetos para banco de dados ORACLE(PL/SQL);
  • Ferramenta de controle de versão GIT;
  • Experiência na criação de API REST;
  • Conhecimento da framework Horse;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Orientação a Objetos;
  • Testes unitários (DUnit);
  • Diferencial: conhecimento nas ferramentas: DevExpress, Report Builder, componentes BD e ACBr;
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento:
  • Clean Code;
  • Programação Defensiva;
  • SOLID;
  • Design Patterns;
  • MVC;
  • Conhecimento em métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software.

title: Gerente de Relacionamento de Rede I - Postos
description:
Edenred é uma plataforma digital líder em serviços e pagamentos e a companhia diária para as pessoas no trabalho, conectando mais de 850.000 clientes corporativos, 50 milhões de usuários, 2 milhões de comerciantes parceiros em 46 países por meio de 4 linhas de negócios:

• MOVE: Gestão de Combustível e Frota, Frete, Manutenção, Pedágio

• EAT & CARE: Refeições e Alimentos, Cultura, Incentivos & Recompensas e Saúde

• PAY: Gestão de despesas, pagamento de salários e comissões para trabalhadores independentes e prestadores de serviços

• ACQUIRING: soluções para comerciantes

Estamos no centro de uma rede virtuosa que agrega valor aos seus clientes:

• Empresas e setor público, preocupados em ser empregadores atraentes, motivando suas equipes e otimizando seu desempenho

• Funcionários e cidadãos, que apreciam a simplicidade e conveniência de nossas soluções de pagamento para tornar suas vidas mais fáceis

• Comerciantes (restaurantes, lojas, postos de gasolina, etc.) que buscam aumentar sua receita, fidelizar seus clientes e tornar suas transações mais seguras

Nossos 10.000 funcionários estão comprometidos em tornar o mundo do trabalho um lugar melhor para todos, mais seguro, eficiente e fácil de usar

Com 1.500 funcionários, nossa linha de negócios MOVE no Brasil é a maior do grupo. Estamos agora regionalizando nossas operações MOVE em nível LATAM, proporcionando assim exposição internacional e oportunidades para nossos funcionários. Daqui para frente, nossa linha de negócios continuará a entregar um crescimento sustentável e lucrativo de dois dígitos

Procuramos talentos que partilhem a nossa ambição, que queiram representar, desafiem-nos e a si próprios a seguir em frente todos os dias. Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor

Na Edenred, acreditamos que grandes conexões são uma força imparável. Nós os canalizamos para fortalecer negócios e fomentar soluções inclusivas. Criamos ecossistemas locais que criam mais riqueza. E mais saúde. Não só para as pessoas, mas também para o nosso meio ambiente. Melhores laços podem melhorar a vida. Damos a eles um propósito: promover o progresso.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade.

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

Para todos que procuram esse tipo de VIBE em sua vida profissional, somos o melhor lugar para você!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Gestão de Carteira: Gerenciar o portfólio de Postos Credenciados Edenred, com foco em estratégias de renegociação, rentabilização e retenção.
  • Expansão Estratégica: Atuar ativamente na expansão da rede através de novos credenciamentos estratégicos.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.

Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.

All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration, and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.

Job responsibilities:

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm, DFSMShsm, and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.

Key skills:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO, ISPF, and JCL.
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System.
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E.
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z.
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Vendedor(a) de Atacado Materiais de Construção B2B - PJ (Presencial)
description:
Sobre a Big Obra

A Big Obra é uma operação focada em produtos importados para construção, com atuação em varejo, marketplaces e atacado, trabalhando com volume, giro e preço competitivo.

Estamos estruturando o canal de vendas atacado B2B, com foco em giro rápido de estoque, geração de caixa e crescimento sustentável.

Missão da vaga

Atuar na venda atacadista (B2B) de produtos importados da Big Obra, com foco em:

  • Venda em volume
  • Giro de estoque
  • Geração de caixa
  • Respeito à política de preços e margens

Esta vaga é para profissional de atacado.

Não é vaga de varejo ou venda consultiva premium.

Responsabilidades
  • Atuar de forma presencial na operação Big Obra
  • Vender produtos importados liberados para atacado
  • Prospecção e ativação de carteira de clientes B2B já existente
  • Abertura de novos clientes atacadistas
  • Venda em lotes mínimos pré-definidos
  • Negociação baseada em tabela de preços
  • Fechamento de pedidos com foco em volume, giro e pagamento
  • Registro e acompanhamento das vendas realizadas
Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Atuação como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B / atacado
  • Carteira ativa de clientes (lojistas, revendas, construtoras, distribuidores)
  • Vivência com vendas de volume
  • Perfil disciplinado, orientado a metas e resultados
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com regras claras e política comercial
Não buscamos
  • Vendedor de loja física ou varejo
  • Perfil exclusivamente relacional
  • Profissionais sem carteira ativa
  • Vendedores que dependem de exceções para fechar vendas
Remuneração
  • Fixo mensal (PJ)
  • Comissão variável sobre lucro bruto
  • Modelo de remuneração claro e meritocrático
  • Ganhos proporcionais à performance e giro gerado
O que oferecemos
  • Estoque disponível para pronta entrega
  • Política comercial clara (sem improvisos)
  • Operação estruturada para atacado
  • Autonomia com regras bem definidas
  • Ambiente focado em resultado
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento conforme entrega
Processo seletivo
  • Análise de perfil e carteira de clientes
  • Entrevista objetiva
  • Início com metas claras e acompanhamento

title: Enfermeiro (a) Jr. (Novo Hamburgo - RS)
description:

Por meio da lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras.

title: Profissional de Funilaria e Pintura
description:

title: Vendedor

  • Apresentar e promover programas de relacionamento disponíveis.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas será considerada um diferencial;
  • Facilidade de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento com clientes.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Sobre a Amaris e o Grupo Mantu

A Amaris é uma consultoria internacional de tecnologia e transformação que combina expertise técnica e setorial para impulsionar a inovação e o crescimento de empresas em diversos setores. Como parte do grupo Mantu, estamos expandindo nossa presença no Brasil e buscamos profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia, negócios e relacionamento com clientes.

Desafio do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um Account Manager estratégico e proativo para fortalecer nossa equipe de relacionamento com clientes. Você será o principal ponto de contato para uma carteira de clientes-chave, com foco em garantir a satisfação, retenção e expansão de negócios. Sua atuação será essencial para transformar relacionamentos em parcerias de longo prazo, alinhando as soluções da Amaris às necessidades estratégicas dos clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto de contato estratégico para uma carteira de clientes corporativos;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de confiança com tomadores de decisão (C-levels e gestores);
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de negócios dentro da base de clientes (upselling e cross-selling);
  • Garantir a satisfação do cliente e promover sua retenção por meio de acompanhamento contínuo;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de vendas, consultoria e operações para alinhar entregas e expectativas;
  • Realizar reuniões estratégicas periódicas com clientes para revisão de resultados e planejamento futuro;
  • Monitorar KPIs de relacionamento e performance comercial;
  • Apoiar na prospecção de novos negócios junto com o time de Business Development.

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de contas estratégicas, preferencialmente em empresas de consultoria, tecnologia ou serviços profissionais;
  • Habilidade com negociação, escuta ativa e pensamento consultivo;
  • Perfil relacional, com ótima comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Domínio do português e inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação);
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia e em ambiente dinâmico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência no setor de tecnologia, transformação digital ou consultoria;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, ERP (SAP, Oracle), ou projetos de TI;
  • Networking no mercado corporativo brasileiro.

O que Oferecemos

  • Ambiente inovador e multicultural;
  • Oportunidade de atuar em projetos desafiadores com impacto real;
  • Plano de carreira com desenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Benefícios competitivos (Plano de saúde, VR/VA, PLR, etc.);

title: Senior Manager, Regional Key Account Management
description:
This position will be accountable for managing, directing and leading the CEVA Logistics programs for BYD across the LATAM region.

Key Accountabilities

1

Ability to understand unique customer supply chain requirements and drive a particular sector focus

2

Identify business opportunities that add value to BYD logistics programs whilst generating business leads that meet and exceed business goals

3

Expansion/Growth is mission critical to the role. Senior relationship management and service execution are two key components to insure account expansion/growth is achieved

4

Retention is key to grow portfolio of business across all product/service types within CEVA

5

Drive collaborative efforts between country and multiple product leaders within CEVA to meet the needs of customers

6

Prospecting for all products opportunities and delivering compelling solutions, value and pricing

7

Maintain an Account Plan for the customer that will encompass a strategic roadmap defining multi-year growth, targets by key supply chain

8

Execute Account Plans (forecasts, budgets and operating plans)

9

Ability to work in a matrix organization along with virtual teams & build strong internal relationships with Sponsor/Global/Regional/Sector team leaders as required for the account

10

Build strategic relationships with key contacts within customer organizations to understand opportunities for creating value

11

Stay aligned and team work with GKAM and other region RKAMs

12

Conduct regular business review meetings with customers and drive meeting content to ensure operations, support and execution teams are present to support these reviews

13

Responsible to communicate all expectations on these review meetings to the operations and support teams for implementation or improvements

14

Lead & create innovation solution with team based on deep understanding of business streams of customer

15

Leverage on Sectors Focused Solutions to penetrate account growth and development (Eg. Use of case studies and key SMART solutions within CEVA)

16

Work with implementation teams on new projects to ensure customer expectations are communicated

17

Lead and work with customer to resolve all contractual and commercial decisions in compliance with CEVA policies and terms

18

Continue cross selling within CEVA and CMA CGM group to maximize biz portfolio for the group

19

Accurate and timely update of all customer engagement activities and business development opportunities within C-View

20

Need to support other China-Brazil sales leads and Chinese projects/business

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years industry experience.
  • Minimum 8 years account management managerial and/or customer relationship management experience required.
  • Bachelor degree holder majoring in supply chain/logistics/ /transportation management/sales and marketing/international business
  • In-depth knowledge of all air,sea, ground and contract logistics products and services.
  • Excellent planning, time management, collaboration, decision making, organization, presentation and negotiating skills.
  • Strong background in sales and marketing and a proven track recordin business development and growth.
  • Demonstrated success in managing (KPI's) Key Performance Indicators.
  • Demonstrated success in problem solving through use of data and information metrics and improvement to performance process.
  • Proficient in project management methodologies with a focus on managing solution driven strategy plans to achieve goals.
  • Experienced in financial management (P&L's, Balance Sheets,forecasting and budgets) to effectuate return on investment.
  • Manages complex or emotional customer situations promptly andprofessionally meeting commitments for service and assistance.
  • Maintains stable performance underpressure or opposition; handling stress in a mannerthat is acceptable to others and the organization.
  • Uses appropriate methods and a flexible interpersonal style to help build a cohesive teamand facilitates the completion of team goals.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Fluent in both Chinese and English
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook);

title: Assessor de Investimentos Experiente
description:
Você quer trabalhar em uma Corretora de Valores com plano de carreira bem definido e personalizado, que dê a você todo o suporte necessário para alavancar sua carreira, com regras claras para seu bônus e uma trilha real de crescimento?

Na EQI Investimentos, você encontra uma Corretora focada no atendimento de clientes "Private", onde seu trabalho é valorizado: remuneração é competitiva, autonomia para negociar, plano de crescimento estruturado, liderança próxima, suporte integral, tecnologia e oportunidades para evoluir na carreira de "Wealth Management" ou empreender para ter seu escritório B2B. Aqui você tem oportunidades sob medida para umas verdadeiras evoluções na sua carreira.

Na EQI, sabemos que seus sonhos são únicos, reconhecemos suas conquistas e oferecemos estrutura real para você ir além.

Candidate-se agora e transforme seu futuro.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com investidores de alta renda em todo o Brasil;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes através de visitas e contatos recorrentes;
  • Assessorar e acompanhar a carteira de investimentos do cliente com foco em seus objetivos;
  • Atuar estrategicamente em alocação de recursos e proteção de capital.

O que esperamos de você

  • Formação cursando ou completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificação CPA-20, CEA ou CFP — ou interesse em conquistar a CPA-20 (com suporte da EQI);
  • Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, além de perfil colaborativo, com alta capacidade de influência e construção de relacionamentos;

O que oferecemos

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado.
  • Treinamento contínuo e capacitação para evolução técnica e comportamental.
  • Estrutura de Marketing e Eventos para apoio à prospecção de clientes.
  • Estrutura de SDR (Sales Development Representative) para qualificação de leads.
  • CRM Salesforce para gestão de funil de vendas.

Benefícios

  • VA/VR de R$ 1.812
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed
  • Vale Transporte
  • Auxílio Creche
  • ️ Gympass
  • Programa EQI VC+ (descontos com parceiros)

Etapas do processo seletivo

  • Cadastro
  • Conversa inicial com o time de recrutamento
  • Bate-papo com gestor
  • Proposta
  • Contratação
